associate_tag_note: Left blank on purpose. No Amazon Associates tag was supplied with this project. Amazon requires the tag as a URL parameter on every Special Link (Program Policies, Participation Requirements §2(b)). While this is blank, build_site.py renders every outbound link as a plain untagged /dp/<ASIN> URL and stamps a visible 'tag pending' warning on the site. Set it to your real tag (format XXXXX-20) and re-run the build. See flagged item F-10.

site.disclosure_general_note: This wording follows the FTC's own example for affiliate disclosure, which states: “You could say something like, ‘I get commissions for purchases made through links in this post.’” The FTC also warns that “affiliate link” alone is inadequate.
